name: Amazon Neptune Analytics
tagline: Memory-optimized AWS graph engine for fast algorithms, openCypher and vector search over large graphs.
description: Neptune Analytics is a separate AWS service from Neptune Database: a memory-optimized graph engine that loads a graph from S3 or a Neptune cluster snapshot into RAM and runs built-in algorithms (PageRank, community detection, path finding, similarity) and low-latency openCypher queries over it. Each graph can hold a vector index, so similarity search and traversal combine in one query, and it backs the managed GraphRAG option in Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Capacity is provisioned in memory-optimized Neptune Capacity Units. Use it for exploratory analytics, data science and GraphRAG on AWS, alongside Neptune Database for transactional work.

pricing.notes: Billed per memory-optimized Neptune Capacity Unit (m-NCU) hour plus snapshot storage.

scale.notes: Graph size is bounded by the provisioned memory capacity of a single graph.

strengths: Built-in graph algorithms callable from openCypher with no separate compute cluster
In-memory engine loads billions of edges from S3 or Neptune snapshots quickly
Vector index inside the graph combines similarity search with traversal
Managed GraphRAG via Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
weaknesses: AWS-only and billed for provisioned memory even when idle
openCypher only; no Gremlin or SPARQL
One vector index per graph and limited transactional semantics
useCases: Graph data science and community detection
Ad-hoc analysis of Neptune Database snapshots
